title: A local approach to a programme of Meierfrankenfeld: initial setting and the symmetric case
summary: A large $p$-subgroup of a group $G$ is a self-centralizing $p$-subgroup $Q \le G$ whose normalizer controls the normalizers of all the non-trivial, central subgroups of $Q$. In 2016 Meierfrankenfeld, Stellmacher and Stroth produced a result describing the $p$-local structure of a finite group having a large $p$-subgroup (the main examples arising from finite groups of Lie type in defining characteristic $p$). This result is a major success within the wider framework of studying groups of local characteristic $p$. We attempt to produce a result analogous to that of Meierfrankenfeld,…
